priorityTier.title: Priority Tier
priorityTier.description: Human-friendly lead priority (Hot Lead, Top Opportunity, Warm / SEO Signal, Market Gap).

recordType.title: Record Type
recordType.description: Machine-readable bucket for filtering in API/n8n/Zapier automations.

solvabilityScore.title: Solvability Score (0-50)
solvabilityScore.description: How directly your Verified Capabilities Ledger resolves the complaint.

urgencyScore.title: Urgency Score (0-30)
urgencyScore.description: Switching/buying urgency expressed by the author.

recencyScore.title: Recency Score (0-20)
recencyScore.description: Deterministic freshness score based on post age.

recommendedAction.title: Recommended Next Step
recommendedAction.description: Exact action the founder should take with this row.
recommendedAction.example: Reply publicly with Draft A (follow anti-ban rule)

outreachStatus.title: Outreach Status
outreachStatus.description: Workflow tracker column pre-filled for Google Sheets, Excel, Notion, or CRM imports.

source.title: Platform
source.description: Source channel (reddit, hacker_news, google_serp, bluesky, g2).

subSource.title: Community / Site
subSource.description: Exact subreddit, forum, or review domain (e.g., r/AZURE, Hacker News, capterra.com).

authorHandle.title: Author Handle
authorHandle.description: Public username or 'Public Web Post' when sourced via search snippet.

competitorMentioned.title: Competitor
competitorMentioned.description: Competitor product mentioned in the complaint.

painCategory.title: Pain Theme
painCategory.description: Normalized complaint theme for aggregation and content strategy.

painSummary.title: Customer Pain Summary
painSummary.description: Concise 1-sentence summary of the user's stated frustration or requirement.
painSummary.example: User is looking for alternatives to Microsoft Azure support.

verifiedProof.title: Verified Capabilities (Flat Text)
verifiedProof.description: Single-column formatted list of exact Verified Capabilities for clean CSV/Excel exports.

matchedCapabilities.title: Matched Capabilities (Array)
matchedCapabilities.description: Structured array of verified capabilities for API/webhook workflows.

claimEvidenceSummary.title: Claim Grounding Evidence
claimEvidenceSummary.description: Summary of exact factual capabilities backing the score and outreach drafts.
claimEvidenceSummary.example: Grounded in: Pay-as-you-go pricing; Global infrastructure

draftPublicReply.title: Draft A (Public Reply)
draftPublicReply.description: Value-first, transparent, anti-ban public reply ready to review and post.
draftPublicReply.example: Before migrating, check if adjusting your current support tier...

draftDirectPitch.title: Draft B (Direct / DM Follow-Up)
draftDirectPitch.description: Concise direct message follow-up if the author asks for details.
draftDirectPitch.example: Saw your post about Azure support costs...

platformSafetyRule.title: Anti-Ban & Privacy Guidance
platformSafetyRule.description: Platform-specific moderation and GDPR compliance guidance.
platformSafetyRule.example: Reddit (r/AZURE): Lead with helpful advice, disclose affiliation clearly.

postTitle.title: Original Post Title
postTitle.description: Headline of the thread or review.
postTitle.example: Are any alternatives to Microsoft Azure support really worth it?

postUrl.title: Original Post URL
postUrl.description: Direct link to the public post.

publishedDate.title: Published Date
publishedDate.description: Readable date string (YYYY-MM-DD or 'Within lookback window').

publishedAt.title: Published Timestamp (ISO)
publishedAt.description: Exact UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when available.

reportUrl.title: Executive Dashboard URL
reportUrl.description: Direct link to the run's interactive REPORT.html dashboard.

actionable_leads.title: Actionable Outreach & CRM Export
actionable_leads.description: Clean spreadsheet-ready table with zero split array columns. Export directly to CSV, Excel, Google Sheets, or Notion.

content_and_seo_insights.title: Competitor Pain & SEO Insights
content_and_seo_insights.description: Score breakdown and pain categories for homepage messaging, SEO comparison pages, and product roadmap planning.

automation_api_full.title: Full JSON / Automation View
automation_api_full.description: Complete structured schema including arrays and metadata for API, MCP, n8n, Make, and Zapier integrations.
